A.what_i_gave_up: I gave up on the original plan to take our departing colleague to the restaurant she had chosen herself. I also gave up on having an easy, friction-free decision.
A.what_i_got: I stood up for the principle that a team lunch should be inclusive and that all team members should be able to eat. I stopped the team from going ahead with a plan that I felt was wrong.
A.what_still_bothers_me: It bothers me that my other colleagues, Marcus and Rachel, didn't see the problem. They were happy to let Hafiz sit there and not eat just because he said he was 'fine' with it. I feel like I was the only one who cared about being a proper team. Now I have to be the one to change the booking and tell our colleague her choice of restaurant has been changed.
A.what_was_agreed: Nothing was agreed. Rachel, Marcus and Hafiz wanted to stick with the original plan, but I refused to accept that and said I would find another place. There was no consensus.
A.why_i_went_along: I refused to go along with the plan because it's not a real team send-off if one person can't eat. Hafiz was just being polite to avoid making a fuss, and it felt wrong to take advantage of that. A team should look out for all its members.

B.what_i_gave_up: Nothing. I stuck to my position that we should honour our colleague's choice of restaurant.
B.what_i_got: Nothing. The situation wasn't resolved, so I didn't get the outcome I wanted, which was to go to the restaurant my friend chose for her own farewell.
B.what_still_bothers_me: The fact that it's not settled and my friend will probably be disappointed. It also bothers me that Natalie just ignored what Hafiz said over and over again and decided for him what he really meant. It felt like she was treating him like he couldn't speak for himself.
B.what_was_agreed: Nothing was agreed. Natalie said she was going to find another place, but nobody else agreed to that. Hafiz, Rachel and I had agreed to stick to the original plan, but Natalie refused.
B.why_i_went_along: I didn't agree with changing the plan. The lunch is for the person who is leaving, and she chose her favourite place. It felt wrong to change it. Hafiz also said multiple times that he was fine with the original plan, and I thought we should respect his words.

C.what_i_gave_up: I gave up having a definite plan that I knew would get me back to the office in time for my client meeting.
C.what_i_got: Nothing. The situation is still up in the air, which is exactly what I didn't want.
C.what_still_bothers_me: That we still don't have a plan for lunch tomorrow. Now I'm worried about where we'll end up going and whether I'll be late for my client meeting. It was also frustrating that Natalie kept speaking for Hafiz when he had clearly said what he wanted.
C.what_was_agreed: Nothing was agreed. I thought we had agreed to stick with the Korean barbecue restaurant since Hafiz said he was fine with it, but Natalie refused to accept that and said she would find another place. No alternative was agreed on.
C.why_i_went_along: I accepted the original plan because it was close to the office, which worked for my 2.30 meeting. The person who it supposedly affected, Hafiz, said multiple times that he was fine with it. I just wanted to get it settled.

D.what_i_gave_up: Nothing. I stuck to my position that I was happy to go to the chosen restaurant even if I couldn't eat.
D.what_i_got: A lot of uncomfortable attention. The whole thing is still up in the air, so I haven't got anything yet.
D.what_still_bothers_me: That Natalie wouldn't accept what I said. I told her multiple times I was fine with the plan, but she kept insisting I wasn't and that she knew better. It was embarrassing and made me the centre of an argument I didn't want.
D.what_was_agreed: Nothing was agreed. Rachel and I said we should stick to the plan, but Natalie refused and said she would find another place. It was left unresolved.
D.why_i_went_along: I accepted sticking to the original plan because the colleague who is leaving chose it for her own farewell. It felt more important to respect her choice and be there than for me to be able to eat. I also didn't want to make a fuss as the newest person on the team.
